title: The Quiet End of the Day

pkg.confirmedTitle: The Quiet End of the Day
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft night atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
At the end of the day
the window holds quiet stars
a small wind from the alley
passes through the room

It whispers slowly
you did enough today
and the scattered hours
rest beside the wall

[Chorus]
At the end of the day
evening gently breathes
I finally find a quiet smile

All the moments
gather in the dim light
filling the room
with a calm warmth

[Verse 2]
A pale moon slides
along the edge of the window
soft light settles
in the corner of my room

My tired shoulders
learn to breathe again
even a small sigh
feels warmer now

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and gentle)

[Bridge]
A shadow stretches
across the wooden desk
a teacup slowly cooling
still holds a trace of steam

Somewhere outside
a bicycle bell rings once
and someone’s long walk home
passes quietly through my night

[Chorus]
At the end of the day
evening softly dreams
I finally smile a little wider

All the moments
wrap around my heart
like quiet lights
in a small room

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, delicate fading notes)

The stars still move
beyond the window frame
in this small quiet room
a gentle peace remains
